notes.title: September Update v1.11.0
notes.content:
[h1]September Update 1.11.0[/h1]

- New button activation mechanic
- New free locomotion mode
- Improved font rendering
- Support for custom radio stations
- Added area to practice throwing/deleting items in reception
- Fixed hand animation
- Potential fix for game freezing due to low memory
- New glass shader
- Minor bug fixes

[h2]Follow the game's updates and roadmap at http://gravitylab-game.com/roadmap[/h2]

notes.title: Full Index Support
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25281831/0ce94db6d2bc829cbc1ceec7cd5c1cfa5be18b5a.gif[/img]

[h1]Hey everyone,

Gravity lab is fully ready for your shiny new Index headset and controllers![/h1]

With a lot of optimization and available options, the game can be customized to run [b]up to 144fps[/b] (tested on a GTX1080) while the internal puzzle physics timestep remains compatible across all systems (90hz).

We also support [b]full finger tracking on the new controllers![/b]

See you in Gen2 of VR!

notes.title: Preview of the "Neutron Star" update v1.6 in the beta channel!
notes.content:
[h1]"Neutron Star" Preview[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25281831/e3c1e052411a74cf93bda5ceeb91693418da074b.gif[/img]

Hey everyone,
I have been working on some more content for Gravity Lab!

The "Neutron Star" update will bring 9 new levels, a new environment and a new mechanic.

I am still fine-tuning the levels, but if you are keen, you can check out the first level by switching to the the Beta branch on Steam!


[h1]Includes Knuckles Support[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25281831/08e6a7aa8aa4ca80493d1e7afc5ab7b20250c0c1.gif[/img]
1.6 does include support for Knuckles controllers! However, this support is based on the curl values reported pre-EV2. To use your EV2 Knuckles, you need to manually bind the curl values to the axes in the rebind tool. You need to unhide them in this file though: steamapps\common\SteamVRKnucklesDriver\resources\input\knuckles_profile.json

tags.feature: The "Neutron Star" update will bring 9 new levels, a new environment and a new mechanic.
1.6 does include support for Knuckles controllers!

notes.content:
Hey folks,

I have just pushed update 1.1, which replaces the laser pointer UI and controllers with actual hands.

There are also some minor bug fixes as well as the ability to grab two items at once.

The game has also been renamed to "Gravity Lab - Gravitational Testing Facility & Observations".

notes.title: EAv9 - The Performance Update
notes.content:
Hey folks,

EAv9 should be rolling out over the coming hours. This update mainly focuses on performance. Performance was good to begin with, but now it should be even better!
If you're running a GTX970, you can probably run 4x or even 8x MSAA on the "Fastest" graphics setting with 1.0 renderscale. This is obviously dependent on the level.

If you have any faster card, you should be able to crank everything up to the max and even run high multipliers for renderscale.


One of the main reasons for further performance improvement was the new level editor I am working on. Eventually, players will be able to build their custom environment and while the stock levels are quite minimalist, the performance headroom will greatly help in large custom levels.


This update also adds icons for the level editor & sandbox parts as well fixes some of the level saving issues.

tags.feature: - This update also adds icons for the level editor & sandbox parts

tags.bug: as well fixes some of the level saving issues.

notes.title: EAv6 aka "The Difficult Update" - New Features & Changelog
notes.content:
Hey folks,
I just pushed a new update which adds 3 difficulty options to each level. For some levels. A level's difficulty setting changes the number and availability of spawnable items, i.e. an easy level could allow an infinite amount of a certain item, while harder levels restrict the number.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25281831/90f601b8008337514ff0abe093afecc2127a354f.jpg[/img]

This update also enables level progression, meaning harder levels and difficulty modes will be locked until the previous level or difficulty has been unlocked.

There are also some minor changes in the level  editor to reflect the new difficulty settings.

And last but not least: The hand menu has now a quick toggle to turn off collision of holographic balls. This can be useful if you're fine tuning certain parts and don't want balls to clog up the path.

notes.title: Changelog for Update Early Access v5
notes.content:
This is another small update focusing mainly on changes that will make demoing easier.

Why? Because Grav|Lab will be part of the official demo lineup of the PAX Aus 2016 VR Freeplay Area thanks to HTC :)!

- changed the button label fade out logic
- added Grav|Lab logo to 2d output (can be turned off)
- added option to force audio intro (good for demoing to new players)
- fixed fade out on reset (R on keyboard)
- fixed time bonus (not negative anymore)
